exact_variant: Official checkpoint repository IndexTeam/IndexTTS-2, Hugging Face revision 740dcaff396282ffb241903d150ac011cd4b1ede (metadata last modified 2026-01-20). The upstream GitHub repository is shared with later versions; use the v2 Python API / WebUI mode and checkpoints_2 layout, not v2.5. No additional official quantized/lightweight IndexTTS-2 variant found.
parameter_count: Overall IndexTTS-2 parameter count: not published/found in the inspected official checkpoint card, repository, or paper. The checkpoint contains a directory named qwen0.6bemo4-merge and a 1,192,135,096-byte model.safetensors file; that is an auxiliary emotion-text model component and does not establish the total IndexTTS-2 parameter count.
reported_weight_size: Hugging Face API reports the complete checkpoint repository usedStorage as 5,919,372,763 bytes (includes configs/tokenizer and other assets; not a weight-only total). Individual large files: gpt.pth 3,484,663,079 bytes; s2mel.pth 1,202,198,223 bytes; qwen0.6bemo4-merge/model.safetensors 1,192,135,096 bytes. Exact aggregate weights-only size: not published/found. This is not a lightweight checkpoint by disk footprint; 54 GiB free disk exceeds the repository's reported total, but extra runtime/dependency/cache needs are not specified.
text_description_voice_design: Does NOT meet text-only speaker-description voice design as evidenced. The paper/repo describe natural-language text as a way to specify emotional tendencies (and emotion control), not to define a new speaker identity/timbre. Do not treat emotion prompting as text-designed voice creation.
reference_audio_cloning: Reference-audio voice cloning: yes, zero-shot synthesis conditions on a timbre/speaker reference audio clip; upstream describes cloning from a single reference. This is a distinct workflow and requires audio, so it is not text-only custom voice design. Emotion may default from the timbre prompt or be controlled separately with emotion-reference audio or an emotion vector.
language_and_control_coverage: Official IndexTTS-2 card identifies English (en) and Chinese (zh); paper evaluates English and Chinese. Supports emotional expressiveness/control, including an emotion audio prompt, an 8-value emotion vector and natural-language emotion tendencies per paper/repository. Paper describes duration-token control, but current upstream release notes state precise duration control is not yet enabled in that release—treat duration control as a paper capability, not confirmed usable in the released code. Do not attribute IndexTTS-2.5's later Japanese/Spanish/Arabic coverage or speed features to IndexTTS-2.
code_license: The repository LICENSE and pyproject license field identify the bilibili Model Use License Agreement / LicenseRef-Bilibili-IndexTTS, not Apache-2.0 or an unrestricted permissive license. The agreement defines the model to include final code as well as weights. It grants limited royalty-free use but imposes conditions, including a separate license requirement for organizations/products above 100 million monthly active users or RMB 1 billion annual revenue; other obligations/restrictions apply. Review the agreement, especially because its Chinese version prevails if translations conflict.
weights_license: Same bilibili Model Use License Agreement applies to the IndexTTS-2 weights: its definition explicitly includes model weights. This is a custom conditional use license, not Apache-2.0. Among other terms, the agreement requires downstream recipients to comply, restricts some model-improvement use, and requires separate written permission above its stated scale thresholds. Verify legal suitability for intended use.
cpu_memory_and_runtime_evidence: No official CPU-only inference recipe, CPU performance, minimum RAM, or inference memory requirement found; therefore suitability on 8 CPU cores/23 GiB RAM cannot be confirmed from sources. The paper reports training on 8 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs (training, not inference requirement). Upstream has GPU-oriented optimizations and CUDA guidance; the current pyproject routes Linux/Windows PyTorch to a CUDA 12.8 index, while CUDA kernels/DeepSpeed are optional extras. Current pyproject explicitly requires Python >=3.10,<3.12, so the user's Python 3.12.3 is outside the declared supported range. No evidence that CPU-only operation is impossible, but neither supported CPU operation nor RAM sufficiency is established. OS classifiers say OS Independent; this does not override Python/dependency constraints.
quality_ranking_evidence: No comparable public arena/leaderboard rank found for IndexTTS-2 as of 2026-10-10: it is not among the 28 systems enumerated by Voice Arena's published roster/methodology; no IndexTTS-2 rank/score was found in the inspected Artificial Analysis provider-voice leaderboard extract. Published paper listening benchmark (arXiv version dated 2025-06-23; author-run MOS, not an independent global leaderboard): on LibriSpeech test-clean IndexTTS-2 SMOS 4.44±0.12, PMOS 4.12±0.17, QMOS 4.29±0.14 versus IndexTTS SMOS 4.23±0.14, PMOS 4.02±0.18, QMOS 4.29±0.22; on SeedTTS test-zh IndexTTS-2 SMOS 4.44±0.17, PMOS 4.46±0.11, QMOS 4.54±0.08 versus IndexTTS 4.10±0.09, 3.73±0.23, 4.33±0.17 and CosyVoice2 4.12±0.25, 4.33±0.19, 4.31±0.21. Paper reports 1–5 MOS dimensions and also an author-collected emotion set; these are benchmark scores against the named baselines, not a general quality rank. Results are author-reported; the paper notes limitations of its collected emotion test set.
github_popularity_evidence: Hugging Face model API response captured 2026-10-10 reports 12,100 downloads and 789 likes (popularity signals only, not quality). A current GitHub star count was not captured and is not asserted. Stars/downloads do not measure speech quality.
integration_notes: Official repository documents a local Python API (IndexTTS2 from indextts.infer_v2), a v2 WebUI invocation (--version 2 with checkpoints_2), and CLI entry point indextts2 in pyproject. No official hosted inference service/API is evidenced. Upstream now defaults its README to IndexTTS-2.5, so select v2-specific examples/files carefully. The declared Python range excludes Python 3.12.3; no installation or model download was performed.
caveats: Task cutoff is 2026-10-10; later versions/features are deliberately not credited to IndexTTS-2.
This is reference-audio cloning with separate emotion prompting, not natural-language speaker-description voice design.
No total parameter count, weight-only aggregate bytes, CPU runtime/memory baseline, or minimum RAM is published/found in the inspected sources.
The 5,919,372,763-byte Hugging Face figure is whole-repository storage, not weights-only; per-file sizes are given separately.
Paper MOS is author-reported and task/dataset-specific; it is not equivalent to a TTS Arena rank and does not guarantee quality on this user's CPU or use case.
The upstream source page describes IndexTTS-2.5 as the latest release, with its own expanded language support; those capabilities must not be conflated with IndexTTS-2.
No package/model was installed or downloaded.
License has material restrictions and Chinese text is designated controlling in case of discrepancy; seek legal review for commercial or large-scale use.
